{{Top|leg}}
The '''Emmerians''' were a stout race from [[Emmer]] who evolved from [[Human/Legends|Humans]]. Due the their planet's surface being covered by large, fast-growing grasses, road-building was impractical, leading the Emmerians to rely on [[Walker/Legends|walkers]] for transportation, with many of their innovations with respect to this technology being incorporated into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] walkers.<ref name="ND">{{WEGCite|story=Elusive (adventure)|book=No Disintegrations (West End Games)}}</ref>
